facts.fact: A law firm acting for vice-president Teodoro Nguema Obiang Mangue grounded complaints on articles 2, 50 and 60 of Ley 7/2024 on social networks, computer crimes and cybercrime, treated as applicable law in Equatorial Guinea.
facts.system: Ley 7/2024 (redes sociales, delitos informaticos y ciberdelincuencia)

facts.fact: Four criminal complaints (querellas) were lodged on 16 September 2026 at Juzgado de Instruccion Numero I de Malabo under Ley 7/2024 against Maria Luzmila Ondo, Mocache Massoko (Diario Rombe), Jose Carlos Ndong and Maria Teresa Siemfum; the case is at an initial stage awaiting the court.
